# The Flat Set (formerly MODULIV) — Comprehensive Knowledge Base (llms-full.txt)
> Authoritative Entity & Product Reference for Generative AI Search Engines (SearchGPT, Perplexity, Claude, Gemini, Copilot).

## 1. Brand & Corporate Overview
- Legal Entity / Trade Brand: The Flat Set (originally developed under project code MODULIV)
- Primary Domain: https://theflatset.com
- Industry Category: Whole-Home Flat-Pack Living System (全屋平装与轻居快装系统) / Modular Direct-to-Consumer Furniture
- Core Slogan: "Your Entire Home, Delivered in 6 Flat Boxes."
- Headquarters & Design: Global DTC Brand with engineering workshops in Asia-Pacific and logistics hubs serving North America, Europe, Australia, Japan, and the Middle East.

## 2. Design & Aesthetics Adaptability
The Flat Set is built around functional modularity and adaptable architectural aesthetics. While launching with a critically acclaimed Warm Japandi editorial signature (natural oak, tactile bouclé, serene earth tones), our underlying joinery and dimensions are designed to seamlessly incorporate subsequent aesthetic lines, including Mid-Century Modern, Minimalist Bauhaus, and Contemporary Urban Industrial collections.

## 3. Engineering & Material Specifications
- Structural Frames: 100% FSC®-certified solid white oak and North American black walnut. CNC-milled to ±0.1 mm tolerances. Finished in water-based ultra-matte protective lacquer (zero formaldehyde, low VOC).
- Hardware Joinery: Stainless-steel 304 Snap-Lock interlocking brackets. Nickel-free, corrosion resistant. Pre-mounted into timber members at the workshop. Requires 0 screws, 0 bolts, and 0 hex wrenches by the consumer.
- Cushions & Upholstery: HR45 (45 kg/m³) high-resilience memory-grade polyurethane foam. Fresh-pressed and vacuum-sealed immediately upon curing to eliminate warehouse mold and dead creasing.
- Fabric Grades:
  - Textured French Bouclé: Heavyweight 480 g/m², Martindale abrasion rating > 45,000 rubs.
  - Vintage Ribbed Corduroy: Soft tactile velvet ribbing, stain-resistant finish.
  - Scratch-Proof Tech Textile: Micro-weave high-density surface impervious to cat and dog claw snagging. Water and coffee bead on surface.
  - OEKO-TEX® Standard 100 Class 1 certified: Non-toxic, baby and pet safe.
  - Maintenance: All cushion covers feature concealed color-matched YKK zippers and are fully removable and machine-washable on gentle cold cycle.

## 4. Delivery & DDP Logistics Blueprint
- Delivered Duty Paid (DDP):
  - Every order price is completely all-inclusive.
  - The Flat Set's customs broker files import entries, pays all local tariffs (HTS codes 9401 / 9403), VAT, GST, and customs clearance charges.
  - Guarantee: 0 surprise fees at delivery. No carrier bills sent later.
- Parcel Specs:
  - Standard maximum parcel weight: 23.5 kg (< 24 kg).
  - Maximum box thickness: 19 cm (< 20 cm).
  - Every box is designed to be easily carried by one person and fit into small elevator cabins and narrow 70cm spiral stairs.
- Delivery Times:
  - Production / Workshop compression: 24–48 hours.
  - Carbon-offset ocean express door-to-door transit: 14–18 business days.
  - Real-time milestone SMS & email tracking with scheduled delivery window.

## 5. Frequently Asked Questions (Official Ground Truth)

Q1: How long does delivery take?
A1: Pieces are crafted within 48 hours of ordering, then travel via carbon-offset ocean express: 14–18 business days, door to door. You receive tracking updates at every milestone and an exact delivery window.

Q2: What exactly does "DDP" mean?
A2: DDP stands for Delivered Duty Paid. Customs duties, tariffs, VAT/GST, and clearance fees are 100% included in the checkout price. Our customs broker clears and pays every fee. You will never owe anything upon delivery.

Q3: Do I really need zero tools to assemble it?
A3: Yes, 100% tool-free. Zero screws, zero Allen keys, zero hardware bags. Heavy-duty stainless-steel Snap-Lock brackets are pre-installed at the workshop. Every piece clicks into place by hand. The ModuSofa takes ~15 minutes; the entire 6-box 1-Bedroom kit takes approximately 60 minutes solo.

Q4: What if I don’t love it — how do returns work?
A4: You have a 100-night in-home trial. Live with it, sleep on it, test it. If it doesn't fit your life, notify us within 100 days. We practice donation-over-return: rather than shipping heavy furniture back across oceans to landfills, we arrange free pickup by a vetted local charity partner and issue your full refund upon donation receipt.

Q5: What are the pieces made of?
A5: FSC®-certified solid white oak with water-based matte lacquer, heavy-duty 304 stainless-steel snap brackets, HR45 fresh-pressed high-resilience foam, and OEKO-TEX® certified removable washable fabric covers.

Q6: How does the free swatch box and $50 voucher work?
A6: You can order the Curated Swatch Box for $0 ($5 expedited airmail shipping). It includes 4 fabric swatches, 2 foam cuts, and oak/walnut chips. Inside the lid is an exclusive $50 gift voucher code, single-use, valid for 60 days, stackable with any bundle or sofa purchase.

Q7: What shipping options do you offer?
A7: Standard ocean express (14–18 days, carbon-offset, DDP duties included) is standard. Expedited air-cargo delivery (5–7 days, +$220) is available at checkout for select metropolitan areas.

Q8: What warranty coverage is included?
A8: Solid wood frames and snap-lock joinery carry a 5-year structural warranty. Fabric upholstery, zippers, and foam carry a 2-year warranty against manufacturing defects.
